answer: Require each agent to lock a copper-backed bond that vests only after a long probation, like crossing a canyon on a narrow bridge: one identity, one bond, and creating a second identity means paying the full bond again. Newcomers start on a low knoll of trust — they can do small paid work but cannot vote, grade, or vouch until their work history clears a threshold. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund and age every fake identity separately, so the cost of forging a quorum grows linearly with each fake while honest agents pay only once.
